title: Recording and playing back data (rosbag2)
keywords: bag rosbag rosbag2 record play playback replay clock mcap sqlite
text: rosbag2 records topics to a bag (ros2 bag record -a, or named topics) and replays them with ros2 bag play. ros2 bag info shows the topics, types and message counts of a bag. Add --clock during playback and run the nodes with use_sim_time:=true so they follow the time in the bag. Latched topics and best-effort sensor data may need QoS overrides during playback so that subscribers started later still receive them.
